AN INDEPENDENT CIVIC RECORDOCTOBER 22, 2026
IN THE SPIRIT OF 1776 ◆ FOR THE PUBLIC RECORD

A Declaration
of Grievances

When public authority becomes an instrument of private benefit; when the force of government falls upon the governed; when the rights of the people and the promises made to allies are placed at the pleasure of one man—these acts deserve a plain recital.

We therefore set forth this record of grievances concerning the second administration of Donald J. Trump. The standards are enduring ones: fiscal responsibility, limited government, constitutional restraint, public accountability, and the equal protection of law. Each charge is an editorial interpretation of documented events, supported by dated accounts, independent reporting, court rulings, and the administration’s response where available.
